svg.title: Repositories created per month by category

cc:Work.dc:title: Repositories created per month by category
cc:Work.dc:description: Categories describe catalog use cases. Each repository is counted once, under its first catalog category. Commits include the complete default-branch history, merges, bots and inherited fork history. Creation counts use GitHub creation dates. 18 unavailable repositories are excluded.
